use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — thin controller. Validation lives in StoreEventRequest;
 * capability + persistence + audit live in EventService::createDraft.
 */
class EventController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
        private readonly EventSourceBreakdownReportService $sourceBreakdownReport,
        private readonly EventReportDashboardService $reportDashboard,
        private readonly AudienceBoostCampaignReportService $audienceBoostCampaignReport,
        private readonly EventOperationalLockService $operationalLocks,
        private readonly StreamingAssetOperationsService $streamingAssetOperations,
        private readonly ReplayRecordingDownloadService $recordingDownloads,
    ) {}

    public function create(): View
    {
        if (! authUser()?->currentTeam) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        return view('events::events.create', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => 'events.index'],
                ['label' => __('events.create.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            // Defaults: tomorrow at the current top-of-hour for start, +1 hour for end.
            'defaultStartsAt' => ($startsAt = now()->addDay()->startOfHour())->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultEndsAt' => $startsAt->copy()->addHour()->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultTimezone' => old('timezone', config('app.timezone', 'UTC')),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(StoreEventRequest $request): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        $team = $user->currentTeam;
        if (! $team) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        try {
            $event = $this->eventService->createDraft(
                team: $team,
                actor: $user,
                metadata: $request->eventMetadata(),
            );
        } catch (EventCreditExhaustedException $exception) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return redirect()
                    ->route('events.create')
                    ->withErrors(['create' => $exception->getMessage()])
                    ->withInput()
                    ->with('reference', $exception->errorCode());
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $exception->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ],
            ], $exception->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('events.show', $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.create.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $event->uuid,
                'state' => $event->state->value,
                'title' => $event->title,
                'starts_at' => $event->starts_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'ends_at' => $event->ends_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'timezone' => $event->timezone,
            ],
        ], 201);
    }

    /**
     * S2-2-F1 — render the edit form for a DRAFT event. Non-DRAFT events
     * are blocked at the service layer (EventStateLocked, 409); we also
     * pre-empt them at the controller for a clearer UX, redirecting back
     * to events.show with a flash explaining the lock.
     */
    public function edit(Request $request, Event $event): View|RedirectResponse
    {
        $adminContext = $this->isAdminEventRoute($request);

        try {
            $this->eventService->authorizeEditFormAccess($event, authUser());
        } catch (EventStateLocked) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.edit.unavailable_outside_draft'));
        }

        return view('events::events.edit', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => $this->eventRouteName($request, 'index')],
                ['label' => $event->title, 'route' => $this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), 'parameters' => ['event' => $event->uuid]],
                ['label' => __('events.edit.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            'adminContext' => $adminContext,
            'event' => $event,
            'startsAt' => $event->starts_at?->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'endsAt' => $event->ends_at?->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),
            'eventActions' => $this->eventActionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * S2-2-F1 — apply a metadata update. EventMetadataService refuses
     * non-DRAFT writes (EventStateLocked, 409) and silently drops keys
     * outside the allowed list, so the controller is thin: validate +
     * delegate + branch HTML/JSON.
     */
    public function update(UpdateEventRequest $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        try {
            $updated = $this->eventService->updateMetadata($event, $user, $request->eventMetadata());
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
                return redirect()
                    ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)
                    ->withErrors(['update' => __('events.errors.state_locked')])
                    ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
            }

            return response()->json([
                'error' => ['code' => $e->errorCode(), 'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked')],
            ], $e->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $updated)
                ->with('status', __('events.edit.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $updated->uuid,
                'state' => $updated->state->value,
                'title' => $updated->title,
                'description' => $updated->description,
                'starts_at' => $updated->starts_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'ends_at' => $updated->ends_at?->toIso8601String(),
                'timezone' => $updated->timezone,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function publish(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->publish($event, authUser());
        } catch (PlatformKillSwitchActiveException $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'),
                    'switch' => $e->key->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'));
        } catch (EventOperationalLockActive $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'));
        } catch (PlanGateFailed $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.prepare.errors.plan_gate'),
                    'entitlement' => $e->entitlement,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.prepare.errors.plan_gate'));
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.state_locked'));
        } catch (PublishPrerequisiteMissing $e) {
            $message = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? __("events.publish.audit_status.{$e->auditStatus->value}")
                : __('events.publish.unavailable.landing_required');

            $audit = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? ['status' => $e->auditStatus->value]
                : null;

            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $message,
                    'prerequisite' => $e->prerequisite,
                    ...($audit === null ? [] : ['audit' => $audit]),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), $message);
        } catch (IllegalStateTransition $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.illegal_transition'),
                    'from' => $e->from->value,
                    'to' => $e->to->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.illegal_transition', [
                'from' => $e->from->label(),
                'to' => $e->to->label(),
            ]));
        } catch (AuthorizationException) {
            // @codeCoverageIgnore
            // TeamScope makes this branch unreachable via HTTP (route model binding
            // returns 404 for foreign events before the controller fires). Retained
            // as defensive depth for future non-HTTP entry points (Livewire,
            // console commands, queued jobs) that may call EventService::publish()
            // after bypassing TeamScope via withoutGlobalScopes. The
            // AuthorizationException path in EventService::authorizeEventPublish()
            // is covered by PublishEventTest::it_throws_if_actor_lacks_publish_capability().
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => 'JKM-EVT-1010',
                    'message' => __('events.errors.unauthorized'),
                ],
            ], 403, __('events.errors.unauthorized'));
        }

        $payload = [
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $result->uuid,
                'state' => $result->state->value,
            ],
        ];

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $result)
                ->with('status', __('events.publish.success'));
        }

        return response()->json($payload, 200);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-5 — Cancel an event. Route was missing from routes.php; registered in Story 2-4 R1.
     * Thin controller: validation + service delegation.
     */
    public function cancel(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:500']]);

        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->cancel($event, authUser(), $request->string('reason')->toString());
        } catch (EventStateLocked $e) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => ['code' => $e->errorCode(), 'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked')],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.state_locked'));
        } catch (IllegalStateTransition $e) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.illegal_transition'),
                    'from' => $e->from->value,
                    'to' => $e->to->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.illegal_transition', [
                'from' => $e->from->label(),
                'to' => $e->to->label(),
            ]));
        } catch (AuthorizationException) {
            return $this->cancelErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => ['code' => 'JKM-EVT-1010', 'message' => __('events.errors.unauthorized')],
            ], 403, __('events.errors.unauthorized'));
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->with('status', __('events.list.messages.cancelled'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => ['uuid' => $result->uuid, 'state' => $result->state->value],
        ]);
    }

                event: $event,
                actor: authUser(),
                reason: $request->string('reason')->toString(),
            );
        } catch (EventDomainException $e) {
            return $this->domainErrorResponse($request, $e, 'moderation');
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->with('status', __('events.show.moderation.messages.suspended'));

    /** Keep bookmarked Prepare URLs working while the workflow lives in Control Room. */
    public function prepareRedirect(Event $event): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, authUser());

        return redirect()->route('events.control-room', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function publishErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            $auditStatus = data_get($payload, 'error.audit.status');

            if (is_string($auditStatus)) {
                return redirect()
                    ->back()
                    ->with('publish_audit_status', $auditStatus);
            }

            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function isAdminEventRoute(Request $request): bool
    {
        return $request->routeIs('admin.events.*');
    }

    private function eventRouteName(Request $request, string $suffix): string
    {
        return ($this->isAdminEventRoute($request) ? 'admin.events.' : 'events.').$suffix;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function cancelErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['cancel' => $message]);
        }

        return response()->json($payload, $status);
    }

    private function domainErrorResponse(Request $request, EventDomainException $e, string $errorBag): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([$errorBag => __('events.errors.domain_error')])
                ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
        }

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                'message' => __('events.errors.domain_error'),
            ],
        ], $e->httpStatus());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: string, name: string, offset: int}>
     */
    private function timezoneOptions(): array
    {
        $now = new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $options = array_map(static function (string $timezone) use ($now): array {
            $offset = (new DateTimeZone($timezone))->getOffset($now);

            return [
                'id' => $timezone,
                'name' => sprintf('%s %s', self::formatOffset($offset), $timezone),
                'offset' => $offset,
            ];
        }, DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers(DateTimeZone::ALL));

        usort($options, static function (array $left, array $right): int {
            if ($left['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return -1;
            }

            if ($right['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return 1;
            }

            return [abs($left['offset']), -$left['offset'], $left['id']]
                <=> [abs($right['offset']), -$right['offset'], $right['id']];
        });

        return $options;
    }

    private static function formatOffset(int $offset): string
    {
        $sign = $offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        $absolute = abs($offset);
        $hours = intdiv($absolute, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($absolute % 3600, 60);

        return sprintf('UTC%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes);
    }

# Events Module — agent rules

## Canonical specs to read BEFORE editing

- `docs/specs/event-states.md` — 8-state machine, 19 legal edges (PF-1 Reading A reconciled 2026-04-25).
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/event-service-sketch-2026-04-25.md` — full EventService contract for the epic.
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/test-design-epic-2.md` — risk model, P0 coverage, fixture strategy.

## BMAD workflow fidelity

If a BMAD skill is named or required by the active flow, follow the real skill workflow. Do not substitute a hand-written "equivalent" artifact and do not mark the phase complete until the required skill outputs exist on disk.

## Hard rules

1. **Never write business logic or direct queries in Livewire/controllers.** No `Model::query()`, `::where()`, `::find()`, `->paginate()`, or `DB::table()` calls inside any Livewire component or controller — even for reads. All data access goes through `EventService`. Controllers stay thin (validation + delegation + serialisation).
2. **Never bypass the state machine.** State writes ONLY via `EventService::transition()` or its wrappers (`publish`, `cancel`, `suspend`, `reactivate`). Direct `$event->state = ...; $event->save()` is forbidden.
3. **Single transaction for state + audit.** Every state-changing method writes the new state AND emits the audit row in the same `DB::transaction()` block. Audit failure rolls back state.
4. **Lock before re-checking state.** Inside `transition()`, the row is `lockForUpdate()`ed and state + `cancelled_at` are re-read inside the lock before the next state is computed.
5. **Domain events fire AFTER commit.** Use `DB::afterCommit()` or the post-tx dispatch pattern. Never dispatch a Laravel event inside the tx.
6. **Capability via Authz package.** Routes use `route.permission` middleware + `config/route_permissions.php`. Never write a custom `Ensure*` middleware. Capabilities are 3-segment dotted (e.g., `events.create.team`).
7. **Module views.** All views live under `app/Modules/Events/Resources/views/`. Render with `view('events::...')`. No views under `resources/views/events/`.
8. **i18n.** All user-facing strings via `__('events.*')`. Keys live in `lang/en/events.php` and `lang/tr/events.php` and must be parity-tested.
9. **TeamScope bypass discipline.** Do not call `->withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)` inside `EventService` / `SpeakerService` / `EventRepository` for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team work — that is already handled at the scope layer by `User::shouldBypassTeamScope()`. Bypass is legitimate only for:
   - public visitor surfaces with no tenant context (`findPublicLandingEvent`, `findPublicRegistrant`, `findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent`, `resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation`), and
   - tenant-less infrastructure (`PruneCancelledEventRegistrations` cron, `SendAutomationJob` queued job, `TeamScope::extend` macro definitions).
   Authorise (or apply the equivalent public-visibility / signed-URL guard) BEFORE the bypass, never after. Read `docs/handbook/01_Architecture_and_Concepts/TeamScope_Bypass_Convention.md` before adding any new bypass site.

## Story map (Epic 2)

| Story | Scope | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2-1 | Module bootstrap, EventState enum, Event model, createDraft | done in this commit |
| 2-2 | updateMetadata, Speaker model | next |
| 2-3a | transition() + force-end + race coverage | needs PF-4 NFR |
| 2-3b | publish() wrapper + plan-gate triple-lock | needs PF-4 NFR + 2-3a |
| 2-4 | Event list + dashboard views | depends on 2-1 + 2-3a |
| 2-5 | cancel() + notifications + GDPR sweep | depends on 2-3a |
| 2-6 | suspend(), reactivate(), forceEnd() | needs PF-4 NFR |
| 2-7 | Prepare checklist | depends on 2-3a + 2-1 |
| 2-8 | Timezone display cascade | independent |
